name: Menethil Bay
summary: Alliance ships cross Menethil Bay along the Wetlands' western coast. Its sheltered waters open into Baradin Bay, between Menethil Harbor to the north and Dun Morogh's steep cliffs to the south. Crocolisks prowl the shallows, and sunken vessels lie below.

sections.title: Sheltered Waters of the Wetlands
sections.body: Menethil Bay opens from the Wetlands into the Great Sea, within Baradin Bay. Menethil Harbor lies to the north, Black Channel Marsh to the east, and Dun Morogh's coastal bluffs to the south. Crocolisks of many sizes prowl the shallows and marshy shores. Without a guide, travelers risk the waters. Alliance ships cross the bay, and near its mouth lies the ruined Flying Osprey, a warning of wreckage below.

faq.q: Where exactly is Menethil Bay located?
faq.answer: Menethil Bay runs along the Wetlands' western coast, within Baradin Bay. Menethil Harbor lies to the north, Black Channel Marsh to the east, and Dun Morogh's northern cliffs to the south.

faq.q: What creatures live in Menethil Bay?
faq.answer: Crocolisks of many sizes live along Menethil Bay's marshy shores and shallow inlets. They ambush unwary swimmers, and leatherworkers hunt them for their valuable hides.

faq.q: What is the sunken ship in the bay?
faq.answer: The wreck near Menethil Bay's entrance is the Flying Osprey. It lies beneath the coastal waters near the harbor approaches.

faq.q: Why is the bay important to the Alliance?
faq.answer: Menethil Bay shelters Menethil Harbor, the primary naval gate linking Ironforge and the northern lands of Khaz Modan to Kalimdor and the south. Ships traveling to and from Theramore and Darkshore cross these waters.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Menethil Bay is the sea approach to Menethil Harbor. It protects the fragile route linking Ironforge and Stormwind to Kalimdor.
